Your Responsibilities
- Develop and enhance software for advanced digital printing systems.
- Build web-based user interfaces and control functions for job, colour, and media management.
- Design, implement, test, and document innovative software solutions.
- Develop interfaces for seamless integration with customer IT environments.
- Collaborate with international, cross-functional teams, including UX, quality assurance, and hardware development.
Your Profile
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
- Interest in full-stack web development and interface development.
- Knowledge of technologies such as C#, Python, Angular, HTML5, Git, or Robot Framework.
- Good communication skills in German and English.
- Interest in usability, visualisation, and user experience design.
- Willingness to learn new technologies, explore AI applications, and take ownership of your work.
- A collaborative mindset and enthusiasm for working in an international environment.
